run_summary: The research desk identified one actionable transport update regarding real-time information for the Tokaido Shinkansen. Other items, including weather alerts and local tourism campaigns, were reviewed but did not meet the criteria for a single-event publishable article.

candidates.title: Tokaido Shinkansen Real-Time Status Now Available on Japan Travel by NAVITIME
candidates.what_changed: JR Central has integrated real-time operational status information for the Tokaido Shinkansen into the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app.
candidates.why_it_matters: International travelers can now receive live updates on delays or service changes directly within a popular navigation app, improving trip planning and reliability.
candidates.traveler_action: Download or update the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app to access real-time Shinkansen status updates.
